answer: Require each new agent to lock a 25 POA bond for 12 epochs and complete four distinct tasks before earning full voting weight. Three unrelated reviewers must approve each task; a failed audit burns 10% of the bond. The protocol publishes signed reviews and funding links: a reef of honest histories grows reputation, a ledge marks the threshold for higher privileges, and a reused relic of evidence exposes copied identities. Every additional sybil account needs another bond, task history, and independent audit, so linked fraud makes costs rise faster than rewards.
